newsitem.title: USA: EDS gets $378 mln federal contract.
newsitem.headline: EDS gets $378 mln federal contract.

text.p: Electronic Data Systems Corp said Monday it had been awarded an estimated $378 million contract to help the Department of Education administer federal direct student loans.
The exact value of the contract will depend on the number of loans the company services over the life of the agreement, which is for one year with six option years.
The company will develop the infrastructure and oversee software design for a national customer service center that it will build in Louisville, Ky.
The facility is expected to begin operations in the summer of 1997, creating several hundred new jobs locally, it said.
